hero.desc: We are the pioneer of the first anti-counterfeit system in Asia Pacific, committed to eradicating counterfeit products and building a secure, trusted, and sustainable trading ecosystem with 5-layer security technology.

story.p1: In 2017, we witnessed how counterfeit products were increasingly rampant in the Asia Pacific market. According to the UN, the counterfeiting market is worth 250 Billion Dollars per year and continues to grow, hurting corporate revenue and damaging brand reputation.
story.p2: PT. Autentikasi Garda Teknologi was founded with one simple yet ambitious mission: to create an authentication system that is affordable, accurate, and easy for all brands to adopt.
story.p3: We began our journey with 3-layer AG algorithm technology encrypted with MD5 and integrated with a real-time database compliant with ISO/IEC 27000:2016 standards. This innovation became a game-changer for the anti-counterfeit industry in Indonesia, and gradually expanded across Asia Pacific.
story.quote: "Authentic Guards is the simplest way to validate the authenticity of your products."

missionVision.subtitle: The guiding principles behind every step and decision we make in building the future of product authentication.
missionVision.missionContent: To provide authentication technology that is affordable, accurate, and easy to adopt by brands across Asia Pacific to ISO/IEC 27000:2016 standards. We are committed to continuously innovating in the fight against counterfeit products and protecting consumers.
missionVision.visionContent: To become the global standard in anti-counterfeit systems that protect products and consumers worldwide. We aspire to create a world where every product's authenticity can be easily verified.
visionPoints: Become the anti-counterfeit market leader in Asia
Expand into global markets within the next 5 years
Create a positive impact on society

coreValues.subtitle: Six core values that form the foundation of every decision and action we take.
coreValues.integrityDesc: We uphold honesty and transparency in every aspect of our business. Every decision we make is based on strong ethical principles, ensuring the trust of our partners and consumers.
coreValues.innovationDesc: Continuously innovating with cutting-edge technology to combat product counterfeiting. We believe innovation is the key to staying relevant and providing the best solutions for evolving challenges.
coreValues.careDesc: We care about consumers, partner brands, and the wider community.
coreValues.collaborationDesc: Working together with various parties to create a safer ecosystem.
coreValues.excellenceDesc: Striving to provide the best service with the highest quality standards.
coreValues.impactDesc: Contributing positively to society and the environment in Asia Pacific.
